L = require("leaflet@1.9.4")

{
  const link = document.createElement("link")
  link.rel = "stylesheet"
  link.href = "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet/1.9.4/leaflet.min.css"

  { name: "European Food Safety Authority", city: "Parma, Italy", lat: 44.80, lon: 10.33, species: "Bactrocera dorsalis", themes: ["Distribution & Surveillance"], researchers: ["Daria Rzepecka", "Sybren Vos"], papers: 1 },
  { name: "National Institute for Agro-Environmental Sciences", city: "Tsukuba, Japan", lat: 36.02, lon: 140.12, species: "Bactrocera dorsalis", themes: ["Dispersal & Migration"], researchers: ["Naoya Hidaka", "Akira Otuka"], papers: 1 },

  { name: "University of East Anglia", city: "Norwich, UK", lat: 52.62, lon: 1.24, species: "Ceratitis capitata", themes: ["Gene Drives", "CRISPR Tooling"], researchers: ["Philip Leftwich", "Tracey Chapman", "Amber S.K. Hall"], papers: 3 },

colourFor = (species) => species === "Bactrocera dorsalis" ? "#2E7D9E" : "#C05C28"

popupFor = (d) => `
  <div style="font-family:sans-serif;min-width:220px;max-width:280px;font-size:13px">
    <div style="font-weight:700;font-size:15px;margin-bottom:3px">${d.name}</div>
    <div style="color:#666;margin-bottom:6px">${d.city}</div>
    <hr style="margin:6px 0;border-color:#ddd">
    <span style="background:${colourFor(d.species)};color:#fff;border-radius:4px;
      padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;font-style:italic">${d.species}</span>
    <div style="margin-top:8px"><b>Research themes</b><br>
      ${d.themes.map(t => `· ${t}`).join("<br>")}
    </div>
    <div style="margin-top:6px"><b>Key researchers</b><br>
      ${d.researchers.map(r => `· ${r}`).join("<br>")}
    </div>
    <div style="margin-top:6px;color:#888">${d.papers} paper${d.papers !== 1 ? "s" : ""} in database (2026)</div>
  </div>`

{
  const container = DOM.element("div", {
    style: "height:580px;width:100%;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #ddd"
  })
  yield container

  const map = L.map(container, { center: [25, 20], zoom: 2, minZoom: 1 })

  L.tileLayer("https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
    attribution: "© OpenStreetMap contributors",
    maxZoom: 19
  }).addTo(map)

  institutions.forEach(d => {
    const size = 28 + d.papers * 4
    const icon = L.divIcon({
      html: `<div style="
        width:${size}px;
        height:${size}px;
        background:${colourFor(d.species)};
        border-radius:50%;
        border:2.5px solid #fff;
        box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
        display:flex;
        align-items:center;
        justify-content:center;
        font-size:${size * 0.55}px;
        line-height:1;
      ">🪰</div>`,
      className: "",
      iconSize: [size, size],
      iconAnchor: [size / 2, size / 2],
      popupAnchor: [0, -(size / 2)]
    })

    L.marker([d.lat, d.lon], { icon })
      .bindPopup(popupFor(d), { maxWidth: 300 })
      .bindTooltip(d.name, { direction: "top", offset: [0, -(size / 2)] })
      .addTo(map)
  })

  const legend = L.control({ position: "bottomleft" })
  legend.onAdd = () => {
    const div = L.DomUtil.create("div")
    div.innerHTML = `
      <div style="background:#fff;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:6px;
        border:1px solid #ccc;font-family:sans-serif;font-size:12px;line-height:1.8">
        <div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px">Species</div>
        <div>
          <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
            width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:#2E7D9E;
            margin-right:6px;font-size:12px;vertical-align:middle">🪰</span>
          <em>B. dorsalis</em>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
            width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:#C05C28;
            margin-right:6px;font-size:12px;vertical-align:middle">🪰</span>
          <em>C. capitata</em>
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top:6px;color:#888">Bubble size = paper count<br>Click for details</div>
      </div>`
    return div
  }
  legend.addTo(map)
}
